peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (16.9): 1.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 61 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 11). Context, not scored: resales in 4.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Pasir Panjang MRT about 190 m, Labrador Park MRT about 1,180 m; closer than 578 of 662 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 1 within 2 km; nearest Blangah Rise Primary School about 1,730 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 980 m), more than 55 of 662 similar developments (the same as 37); nearest hawker centre Pasir Panjang Food Centre about 240 m; nearest park Kent Ridge Park about 110 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Terra Hill, 98 new sales, about 190 m; Lyndenwoods, 7 new sales, about 1,650 m; The Hillshore, 6 new sales, about 1,770 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,810 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,920 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 44 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 460 new sales and 328 resales (788 purchases); new sales were 58.4% of these purchases. Subsales (53) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 328 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 65 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 328 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 308 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+6.5%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
